claims.text: In an auth collection whose identity fields include both email and a custom username field, a user whose username is itself a valid email address (different from the user's email) can authenticate with auth-with-password using that username as identity, without specifying identityField.
Authenticating with the user's actual email address as identity still succeeds in such a collection.
Authentication with an email-shaped identity still fails when the password is wrong or when no user has that value in any identity field.
Plain (non-email) usernames and an explicit identityField continue to work for password authentication.
